name: Battle.net
summary:
Battle.net is Blizzard’s game launcher site at battle.net. The blue swirl in the tab is the icon account bookmarks use, separate from a single game icon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against battle.net. HTML came from https://www.blizzard.com/en-us/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://d3ukkjpihy42k4.cloudfront.net/images/favicon.b50a2b7ffcd4631c52d2b61e5d6fec8757e5b81a.ico.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. battle.net did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #000b3a comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: png-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 10278 bytes) from https://d3ukkjpihy42k4.cloudfront.net/images/favicon.b50a2b7ffcd4631c52d2b61e5d6fec8757e5b81a.ico.
